name: Upright Bass
author: Versilian Studios (VSCO-2 CE) / packaged for DAW
attribution: VS Chamber Orchestra: Community Edition (VSCO-2 CE) by Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner, Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler/Soundemote). CC0 1.0.
desc: Acoustic upright/double bass, pizzicato (plucked), 2 velocity layers, E1-G4 (MIDI 28-67). Walking jazz bass, acoustic ballads, orchestral pizz bass lines. | Playable MIDI 26-67 (D1-G4), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity).
